rule: Under reviewer_filter automated or codex-only the github-reviewer marks a toplevel or review candidate it skips as noise with its own EYES reaction at step 8, with no commit or push needed, even in a pass with no fixes
description: `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` is the canonical source for marking skipped noise. The source pin, in step 4, carries the condition and the obligation in ONE span: a skipped noise candidate on the `toplevel` or `review` surface is marked at step 8 when `reviewer_filter` is `automated` or `codex-only`; dropping the marking, either filter value or the surface limit turns the suite red. The first consumer pin, in the step-8 `toplevel` / `review` bullet, carries step-4 marked noise as a disposed candidate needing no commit or push, even in a pass with no fixes, joined to the `react-marker.sh` call it runs; dropping the noise case, the no-commit-or-push clause, the no-fixes clause, or separating them from the marker call turns the suite red. The second consumer pin, in `plugin/skills/github-review-loop/scripts/reviewer-identity.jq`, carries the filter definition the rule relies on: under `automated` every candidate is a registry Bot account, so the reviewer marks only bot noise and never a human's comment. What these pins honestly guarantee is exactly that these three word sequences exist in these two named files; they claim nothing about meaning and nothing about runtime behavior. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) the pins are whole-file presence pins, not section-scoped; (2) the `codex-only` line of the filter definition is not pinned, and a change to what `is_bot` accepts that keeps the comment is invisible; (3) the existing `marker-write-failed` fail-closed rule that also covers a failed noise mark is pinned by `tests/policy/safety-react-marker-failclosed.json`, not here; (4) a presence pin cannot assert body-prose absence, so surrounding prose that also marks noise under the `all` or `<author>` filters stays green.

source.pattern: skip noise, marking a `toplevel` or `review` one at step 8 when `reviewer_filter` is `automated` or `codex-only`.

consumers.pattern: or step-4 marked noise (no commit or push needed, even with no fixes), run `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/github-review-loop/scripts/react-marker.sh" "$NODE_ID" "$SURFACE" "$CANDIDATE_URL"`
"automated" any registry entry (Bot account per is_bot).
